not_performed: No product source or index preparation investigation.
No hidden model reasoning read, extracted or summarized.
No golden/reference label text read; only existing aggregate/per-PR numeric scores used.
No network requests, models, corpus execution, engine edits or commits.
interpretation_limits: Final findings are reviewer assertions, not independently verified defects.
Observed change summaries describe returned patch/source evidence, not necessarily the entire PR.
Titles are metadata, not proof of changed code; some retrieved patches begin with unrelated documentation or release metadata.
Potential usefulness of entity/source/endpoint-diff/history tools is an inference, not measured counterfactual benefit.
Different source coverage and findings across arms prevent attributing lower call counts or quality changes to indexing.

provenance.per_pr_bundle_definition: Resolve task_id_prefix uniquely against scopes.json task.id. In arm order B,H and file order tools.jsonl,result.json,findings.json,events.jsonl, compute the SHA-256 of each file's original bytes. For each append UTF-8: attempts\<full-task-id>-<arm>-r0-a0\<filename>, one literal TAB, its lowercase hex digest, one LF. source_bundle_sha256 is SHA-256 of the eight concatenated manifest entries. This binds every pair to all eight source artifacts without copying their sensitive contents.
provenance.events_handling: Event files are provenance inputs; only event metadata/schema was inspected. Analysis uses tools.jsonl call arguments/results and result.json/findings.json final outputs, not assistant reasoning fields.
provenance.evidence_reference: B#n or H#n denotes the sequence field in that PR's tools.jsonl.

metric_definitions.quality_source: Existing quality.per_pr[arm].metrics.overall; precision/recall rounded to four decimals; null remains null. These are custom blinded scores, not official leaderboard scores or new judgments.
metric_definitions.source_retrieval: read_file supplies exact-revision file lines; search supplies matching source snippets; raw_diff supplies changed source and hunk context. None is an entity-source tool call.
metric_definitions.repeated_returned_lines: Repeated numbered read_file lines within the same PR and arm, keyed by exact requested path string and line number; failed calls excluded. This measures duplicate delivery, not overlapping requested ranges.
metric_definitions.truncated_result: A result explicitly marked truncated=true; does not by itself prove the reviewer failed to obtain needed context.
